name: Jezizai
title: Descendant of Gad
summary: Jezizai is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Gad. He is listed in the genealogy of the Gadites who lived in Bashan. He is a lesser-known biblical figure known primarily through genealogical lists.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the Genealogy of Gad
keyEvents.description: Jezizai is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Gad as one of the prominent family heads among the Gadites.

keyEvents.title: The Gadites in Bashan
keyEvents.description: Jezizai and his kin lived in the land of Bashan, in Gilead and its associated cities and the pastures of Sharon.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical Record during Jotham and Jeroboam
keyEvents.description: The genealogical records of the Gadites, including Jeshishai, were recorded during the reigns of King Jotham of Judah and King Jeroboam II of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Family Heads of the Gadites
keyEvents.description: Jeshishai belonged to the group of family heads among the Gadites listed in Chronicles as prominent men of his tribe.
